clips.send: Someone who feels stuck despite working hard sends this to a friend in the same rut: hope - a UPS driver and a pizza cook both built eight- and nine-figure businesses after clearing one mental block, not by working harder.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he picked two ordinary guys to prove a point.

One drove a UPS truck, zero business experience. Kevin cleared a couple of his mental blocks. Within a few years, he was running a $50-million-a-year business.

The other was sleeping on a blow-up mattress in his mother-in-law's basement, working the kitchen at a pizza parlor. Same fix - a couple of blocks cleared.

He built a $150-million-a-year company. Kevin says the guy picked him up for dinner in his own Rolls-Royce Phantom, with a chauffeur and a butler waiting at home.

What's blocking you that has nothing to do with how hard you work?
